nota.pt: CifrasONE obedece a estes interruptores (inclusive no ⚡ Modo DEUS). Desligar vale na hora, mesmo com o app aberto; os atalhos e a busca do AssistONE e religar o AssistONE ou as dicas valem na próxima tela aberta. As ⚙ Configurações nunca somem.
nota.en: CifrasONE follows these switches (including ⚡ GOD mode). Turning off applies right away, even with the app open; AssistONE shortcuts and search, and turning AssistONE or its tips back on, apply on the next screen opened. ⚙ Settings never disappear.
